title: An Email About My Weekend
description: Practise the past simple and linking words, then write an email to a friend about your weekend.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: On Saturday we ___ to the beach with my cousins.
exercises.explanation: The past simple of "go" is irregular: go - went. We do not add -ed.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: I ___ (watch) a film with my sister on Sunday evening.
exercises.explanation: For most regular verbs, add -ed to make the past simple: watch - watched.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: After that, we had a picnic lunch.
We had a picnic lunch after that.
exercises.explanation: "After that" shows the next event in a story. It usually goes at the start of the sentence, followed by a comma.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We didn't went to the cinema because it was closed.
answers: We didn't go to the cinema because it was closed.
We did not go to the cinema because it was closed.
exercises.explanation: After "didn't" we use the base form of the verb: didn't go, not didn't went.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I usually sleep late ___ Sunday mornings.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" with days and with days + parts of the day: on Sunday, on Sunday mornings.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with "so" or "because".
exercises.text: It was very hot, ___ we went swimming in the sea.
exercises.explanation: "So" introduces a result: it was hot (cause), so we went swimming (result).

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: It ___ when we left the beach.
exercises.explanation: We use the past continuous (was/were + -ing) for an action in progress in the past. With "it" we use "was".

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: My cousins ___ (swim) in the sea for hours.
exercises.explanation: "Swim" is irregular: swim - swam - swum.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Where did you go on Saturday?
exercises.explanation: Question word + did + subject + base verb: Where did you go?

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We arrived in home very late on Sunday.
answers: We arrived home very late on Sunday.
exercises.explanation: We say "arrive home" and "get home" with no preposition.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: Sunday was the ___ day of the weekend.
exercises.explanation: Short adjectives ending in one vowel + one consonant double the consonant: hot - the hottest.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with "some" or "any".
exercises.text: We bought ___ ice cream on the beach.
exercises.explanation: We use "some" in positive sentences with uncountable nouns like "ice cream".

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Subject + was/were + -ing: My cousins were building sandcastles.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We plaied volleyball on the beach.
answers: We played volleyball on the beach.
exercises.explanation: Verbs ending in vowel + y keep the y and add -ed: play - played.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: We didn't have ___ time, so we only swam for an hour.
exercises.explanation: "Time" is uncountable here, so we use "much" in negative sentences.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: The sea was ___ (warm) than the swimming pool.
exercises.explanation: Short adjectives add -er to make the comparative: warm - warmer than.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: What are you going to do next weekend?
exercises.explanation: Question word + am/is/are + subject + going to + verb: What are you going to do?

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I usually am tired on Monday mornings.
answers: I am usually tired on Monday mornings.
exercises.explanation: Adverbs of frequency go after the verb "be": I am usually tired.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: A: I can't open this bottle. B: Give it to me. I ___ open it for you.
exercises.explanation: We use "will" + base verb to offer help at the moment of speaking: I will open it.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We stayed at home on Sunday so it was raining.
answers: We stayed at home on Sunday because it was raining.
It was raining, so we stayed at home on Sunday.
exercises.explanation: "Because" introduces a reason; "so" introduces a result. The rain was the reason, so we need "because".

task.prompt: Write an email to your friend Sam about what you did last weekend.
contentPoints: Say where you went and who you were with.
Say how you felt about the weekend.
usefulLanguage: What did you do at the weekend?
task.modelAnswer:
Hi Sam,

How are you? I had a great weekend! On Saturday I went to the beach with my cousins. We swam in the sea and then we ate fish and chips. On Sunday it rained, so I stayed at home and watched two films with my sister. I was very tired but happy.

What did you do at the weekend? Write soon!

Love,
Mia
